name: @journal/spike-home-c-handoff
description: Parent home candidate C — handoff-first home lens prototype (rubric art_VyNYOggs, candidate 3 / todo_wZdouzJU). Standalone spike: bun tests decode synthetic S1 fixtures through the contract schemas; RN screens are typechecked, not executed.

notes.dependencies: Intentionally empty. The repo uses a hoisted pnpm layout (.npmrc node-linker=hoisted), so react, react-native, and effect resolve from the workspace root while typechecking (moduleResolution walks up). This keeps the spike outside pnpm-workspace.yaml globs, exactly like security/ and evaluation/.
